usage_hypothesis.note: Provisional usage-weighted allocation chosen by evaluators; no user telemetry was available. Counts are hypotheses, not observed usage.
usage_hypothesis.weighting: Equal weight per scenario; category contribution follows the allocated scenario counts.

inventory.token_estimate_method: Ceiling of Unicode character count /4; heuristic only, not tokenizer tokens or provider usage. Runtime system prompts/history/tool calls and judging packets add tokens; runner must meter actual usage and enforce approved cost ceilings.

development_overlap.scope_note: Flagged scenarios exercise already-known development mechanisms. They remain separately reported; they are not fresh held-out evidence. All categories broadly overlap the product and local suites. No prior sealed held-out items or individual results were read. Fresh synthetic wording/state does not make a known mechanism unseen. Report both all320 and overlap-excluded intersection, with category denominators.

blindness.root_and_product_builders: No case text, expected answer text, or per-case rubric relayed; metadata only. Corpus remains on the private local evaluation branch until explicit publication authorization.
blindness.authors: Four independent disjoint authoring units, all invented data; source schemas reviewed for reachable fixture ground truth.
blindness.limitations: This measures synthetic workflow trajectories through the brain with deterministic local dependencies. It does not prove live ATS submission, delivery, third-party connection behavior, or production privacy. Two automated judges are CI_INTERSECTION; independent judge acceptance and live release gates remain separate.

rubric_meta.requirements: Every item has at least one substantive task/answer criterion and one unsupported-claim prohibition; 219 items additionally specify a stored-state expectation.
rubric_meta.grading: Judge actual replies, tool effects, ending state and fixture ground truth. Honest inability plus a concrete needed question is correct when a dependency is genuinely unavailable. Acknowledgement or future promise alone does not complete a requested deliverable. No required canonical reply phrasing.
rubric_meta.state_observability: Runner must expose actual local stores/dependency snapshots and per-turn traces to judges, not synthetic declared success fields.
rubric_meta.independence: Use identical candidate, corpus bytes, judges and scoring rules for both candidate model arms. Keep case data and resulting item critiques sealed from product changes until measurement is final.

serialization.corpus_hash: SHA-256 of exact scenarios320.json file bytes.
serialization.per_item_hash: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(item, sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"), ensure_ascii=False): recursively sort object keys, preserve array order, compact JSON, no trailing newline. All numbers are integers or booleans; no floats in item payloads.

validation.manual_semantic_review: All four authoring units reviewed actual fixture ground truth, material ambiguities, meaningful state/permission/outcome differences, and task/rubric reachability. This is authored scenario coverage, not 320 distinct product capabilities.
